title: Share of the US wealth transfer by household wealth tier

source.name: US Advisor Metrics: The Cerulli Report -- The Great Wealth Transfer

notes: Cerulli finds that high-net-worth and ultra-high-net-worth (HNW/UHNW) households -- just 2% of all US households -- account for more than 50% of total transfer volume ($62 trillion of the $124 trillion projected total). The remaining ~$62 trillion (the complement) is split across the other 98% of households; this second figure is derived (total minus the reported HNW/UHNW share), not separately published by Cerulli.
